import parse

# Test R1 more carefully
print('Testing R1 (trailing newline)...')

# Named field {x}
r = parse.parse('{x}', 'hello\n')
print('  {x} with \"hello\\\\n\":', r)

# Anonymous field {}
r2 = parse.parse('{}', 'world\n')
print('  {} with \"world\\\\n\":', r2)

# Multiple fields
r3 = parse.parse('{a}:{b}', 'foo:bar\n')
print('  {a}:{b} with \"foo:bar\\\\n\":', r3)

# Check what happens without newline
r4 = parse.parse('{x}', 'hello')
print('  {x} with \"hello\":', r4)

r5 = parse.parse('{}', 'world')
print('  {} with \"world\":', r5)
"
